column6: Own board lists multiple open roles with August 2026 apply-by deadlines (Data Analyst, Web CMS Specialist, etc).
bioUtah news: CaLycia won Peoples Choice at Altitude Lab Demo Day 2026-04-23; also reported $400K pre-seed from U of U Ventures/Cumming Foundation Jan 2026.
Own careers board live with two open roles (Senior Software Engineer, Lab Technician), fetched 2026-08-13.
Own ATS board live with 10 open Park City roles (Senior Android/iOS/Rust Engineer, Engineering Manager, etc), fetched 2026-08-13.
CleanJoule commissioned CJ1 industrial manufacturing facility near SLC 2025-07-08, per company release picked up by Yahoo Finance; also DoD delivered test fuel and $1.49M DoD award reported.

Clozd announced expanded platform and AI Interviewer 2025-09-09; Lever board (jobs.lever.co/Clozd) blocked automated fetch but wiki page documents live Aug 2026 openings including Staff/Principal Software Engineer.
Locumpedia 2026-06-11 reports CHG (CompHealth parent) still operating locum tenens after a 2026-06-05 restructuring; CompHealth careers still route to the live CHG Workday board.
Own news 2025-12-11: Coreform Cubit 2025.12 released; news archive also lists Cubit 2026.6 (June 2026) and Coreform IGA for Abaqus now available.
Atlanta News First 2026-06-10: Cosm Atlanta LED-dome venue opened at Centennial Yards; CEO Jeb Terry quoted; own careers board also lists live Salt Lake City roles.
Suston 2026-04-24: Cotopaxi published its 2025 Impact Report (FY ending 2026-01-31; approved by 2026-04-30) with ~220 employees and foundation grants.
Long Island Business News 2026-08-07: new Crumbl franchise store grand opening 2026-08-14 in Holbrook NY; chain still expanding from Lindon/Provo HQ.

Last dated signal is 2024-04-04 BillionToOne oncology-validation collab; culmination.com now serves Intermountain MyChart and the Intermountain Culmination URL no longer describes the spinout; no 2025-2026 news, jobs, or dissolution found.

NIH SBIR R44AI186898 (CZ-02 oral Gram-negative antibiotics) still in performance through 2027-06-30; HigherGov record last modified 2026-07-06 shows ongoing status, 70 percent complete, and obligations raised to $3M. RUBRIC-GAP: multi-year grant whose original 2024-07-09 award start is outside 18 months but later obligation/modification is dated 2026.
AirPro 2026-05-07 reports CycloKinetics Inc. launched 2026-05-04 as a Salt Lake City aerospace/defense propellant company (CleanJoule now a subsidiary); U.S. military use claimed since mid-2025.

ThinkGeoEnergy: Cyrq sold Blue Mountain to Ormat as disclosed in Ormat Q1 2025 results 2025-05-07; sale is a portfolio shift, not a terminal event, and Thermo 1 in Beaver County remains in Cyrq's plant list.
Deseret Book posted Church Distribution Sales Associate (West Valley City) 2026-08-13 with close 2026-09-12; page scopes both Deseret Book and Bonneville, which remain DMC operating units.
Yahoo reprint of 2026-05-12 GlobeNewswire: DigiCert (Lehi) awarded Frost & Sullivan 2026 Global DNS Security Competitive Strategy Leadership for DigiCert ONE DNS+PKI work.

Domo 8-K dated 2026-07-22: agreed to sell substantially all operating assets/employees to Progress Software for $400M; close expected by 2026-11-30 so the BI work continues (ruling 3); not a terminal event yet.
FinancialContent/Business Wire 2026-07-22: Eden Tech launched Genesis ROC commercial system; Utah Tech origin, HQ now Proto-Town near Lockhart TX; same desalination work continues.
UDOT 2026-08-06: Ampaire hybrid-electric demo flight SLC-Cedar City used battery technology developed by Utah-based EP Systems as part of uFLY/eIPP launch.
